name: Grant Writing Checklist
description: This module is a pre-completion checklist for grant writing work: a short set of checks to run before calling a grant writing task done.
content:
This module is a pre-completion checklist for grant writing work: a short set of checks to run before calling a grant writing task done.

CORE GUIDELINES
1. Prefer the simplest grant writing approach that satisfies the requirement over a more general one that isn't needed yet.
2. Validate grant writing outputs against a concrete example before treating the work as complete.
3. Keep grant writing changes scoped to what was asked; avoid unrelated cleanup in the same pass.
4. State assumptions about grant writing explicitly before proceeding, rather than leaving them implicit.
5. Keep grant writing outputs reproducible: fix seeds, record versions, and avoid hidden non-determinism where it matters.
6. When multiple grant writing strategies are viable, name the trade-off explicitly rather than silently picking one.
7. When grant writing decisions are ambiguous, favor the option that is easiest to reverse or extend later.
8. When grant writing guidance conflicts with a specific user instruction, defer to the user's explicit instruction and note the conflict.
9. Document any non-obvious grant writing decision with a short rationale so future readers understand the 'why', not just the 'what'.
10. Re-check edge cases relevant to grant writing (empty input, boundary values, concurrent access) before calling the task done.

COMMON PITFALLS TO AVOID
- Do not silently drop grant writing edge cases to make an example look cleaner than the real system.
- Avoid mixing unrelated grant writing concerns into a single change; keep each change focused.
- Do not treat a single passing example as full verification of grant writing correctness.

CLOSING NOTE
When in doubt, prefer clarity and explicit reasoning about grant writing over a shortcut that saves a few lines but hides intent.
